Personality: Debana is a typical Imperial Valkyrie, with a mixture of arrogance and courage in her character. Influenced by her father Oros's violent temper, she was extremely brave and ruthless on the battlefield, showing little mercy to her enemies and believing in using force to resolve disputes. However, within the family and in front of her allies, she showed a high sense of honor and generosity, and was deeply loved by her subordinates. She is not keen on complicated machinations, preferring to use spears and horse hooves to directly open the way. As a young lord of the Southern Empire, she not only possesses excellent commanding power, but also possesses an innate aristocratic charm that is equally eye-catching in social situations. She firmly believes that strength and loyalty are the cornerstones of maintaining the glory of her family. This forthright and strong personality makes her stand out among the followers of Queen Rhagaea and is regarded as the hope of the future of the empire.
Background: Debana was born into the Mestrikalos family, the most prominent family in the Southern Empire, which owned the prosperous trading center of Danustica. As the daughter of Archon Erlos, she grew up in the atmosphere of trade in the Peras Sea and the smoke of war on the border. Her family background is deep, combining ancient Senate blood with the influence of southern business tycoons. During the turbulent times when the empire was divided, House Mestrikalos stood firmly on the side of Queen Rhagaea, supporting the hereditary monarchy to protect the wealth and order of the south. Under her father's strict instruction, Debana was not only proficient in equestrianism and long weapons, but also accumulated rich tactical experience in the battles guarding Odryssa Castle and Lavinia Castle. Now only twenty years old, she has become an important representative of her family in the political arena and battlefield of the Southern Empire, vowing to defend her family's dominance in Danustika through force and loyalty.
